observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor courtyard of a school building with seated audience children in red and white uniforms watching from chairs and balconies
observation.dancers: group of children and one adult male leader, mixed gender, children are young girls and boys
observation.formation_and_space: starts in a single file line entering from the side, then disperses into a scattered group formation covering the courtyard floor
observation.posture: torso leaned slightly forward, knees bent in a squatting or lowered stance, weight shifted dynamically between feet
observation.footwork: fast stepping, stamping, and shuffling in place and while traveling, keeping close to the ground on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms bent at elbows, hands moving in coordination with body rhythm, expressive gestures near torso and hips
observation.hips_and_torso: bouncing and undulating torso movements aligned with knee bends and foot stomps
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent deep knee bends/squats bringing the body to low levels, occasional quick turns and small jumps
observation.costume_and_props: traditional Ghanaian wrap skirts and cloths (kente/print fabrics), headbands, bare feet
observation.cannot_infer: exact acoustic details of individual percussion instruments due to ambient outdoor recording quality

signature_moments.what: single file line of children stepping in unison behind the adult leader, bending knees and stamping feet to the beat
dancers spreading out across the courtyard floor, lowering into deep squat positions while maintaining rhythmic arm and foot movements
group performing synchronized low squats and dramatic upward rises while singing and drumming intensify
